description: Machine-payable, impersonal research feeds over x402: ranked options candidates, dividend/tax-free income, crypto scalp candidates, and best interest-paying cryptos. Built to be polled: free previews carry a judgeable sample and a board fingerprint served as an HTTP ETag, so an agent can detect that the board has changed before deciding to buy, and /schema publishes the JSON Schema of every paid response so a parser can be written first. The full feed settles in XRP/RLUSD (XRPL) or USDC (Base/Arbitrum/Polygon). Not investment advice.
note: Each preview carries a `freshness` block with a board_hash (the ranked lineup, blind to price movement) and a payload_hash (the exact paid bytes), and serves board_hash as a weak HTTP ETag. Poll a preview with If-None-Match to learn whether the board has turned over without paying, and buy only when it has. /schema publishes the JSON Schema of every paid response, derived from the live payload. REQUIRED REQUEST HEADER on every paid request: X-Compliance-Attestation: not-sanctioned-party (a machine-readable attestation that you are not a sanctioned party). A payment presented without it is refused with HTTP 403 before settlement.

resources.name: ranked options candidates
resources.description: Short-term (0-30 DTE) equity/ETF options candidates ranked by signal strength, with observed metrics and an illustrative contract.

resources.name: dividend / tax-free income
resources.description: Dividend-paying equities and municipal-bond funds with computed (tax-equivalent) yields.

resources.name: crypto scalp candidates
resources.description: Ranked cryptocurrency candidates using the same technical signals as the options feed (RSI, ATR, VWAP, momentum) plus a macro overlay (Fear & Greed + news sentiment).

resources.name: best interest-paying cryptos
resources.description: Risk-adjusted DeFi staking and stablecoin yields, plus curated CeFi offers, ranked by pool depth and base-vs-emission share with A/B/C ratings.
